aboutParagraphs: Third-year Computer Science student at Kalimantan Institute of Technology, passionate about building modern web, and intelligent game systems. I enjoy turning ideas into functional digital solutions through web development, machine learning, deep learning, and computer vision (if needed).

Currently exploring AI-driven systems, including automation, predictive modeling, and digital-image analysis. Outside of academics, I enjoy watching films and series such as Breaking Bad, Better Call Saul, and the DC and Marvel universes; playing story-driven and Soulslike games such as God of War, Ghost of Tsushima, and Elden Ring; as well as drawing, listening to music, jogging, and learning new technologies.
